scope: Schema-envelope validation only, excluding control discovery/source parsing, record derivation, authorization, queries, response serialization, CLI startup, and writes.

build.patch: Envelope reuse implementation and benchmark committed with this artifact
build.profile: Cargo release defaults; optimized; no RUSTFLAGS or profile overrides

method.fixture: 32 deterministic valid type/contract envelope values, cycling task_0..31 and example.note_0..31; inline object record schemas; temporary control.md base containing an empty frontmatter envelope
method.legacy: Previous local-reference compilation path, including secure base-file checks and bundled-schema compilation on every call
method.retained: Process-wide immutable envelope validator; actual validation for each input; no result memoization

limitations: Development-machine component comparison, not the 10K/100K acceptance fixture or end-to-end gate
CPU frequency, power state, and unrelated host activity were not controlled
One sequential run; no variance study or process cold-start timing
No concurrent read/write workload, memory-growth evidence, or write-durability measurements
